title: My Ántonia
author: Willa Cather
summary: Jim Burden remembers his childhood on the Nebraska prairie and his friendship with Ántonia Shimerda, a Bohemian immigrant girl. Their lives take different paths as they grow up.
readIf: you like quiet, evocative novels about the American frontier and long friendships.
skipIf: you want a tightly plotted story with high drama.
